title: Island pill opens into a live trip card
summary: A small top pill on a translucent phone over a soft sky widens, adds a middle label, then springs open into a dark status card where a hero image slides in, clouds drift past and a progress bar creeps; it folds back to the pill and loops.
use_when: Showing a live status widget (trip, delivery, order) on a phone
A vertical loop for a feed or a landing page hero
Demonstrating real-time progress without a cut
One calm UI moment with no VO and no music

look.type_style: small grotesk UI labels (about 1 % H); endpoint codes in a bold condensed mono, uppercase, about 2.5 % H; mono micro-captions under the stats

sfx.event: pill springs open into the card
hero image slides into the card
card folds back into the pill

structure.shot: compact black pill at the top of a translucent phone body over a blurred blue sky: status dot + short time left, yellow chip right
structure.camera: drift: sky drifts slowly, scale change about 0.1 %/s (motion.json), pill fixed
structure.motion: pill breathes in width about 10 % on springs.ui 30 fr (overshoot not measurable, ±0.25 s); nothing else moves

structure.shot: pill widens to almost full phone width and a middle label (id, 2 words) fades in between the two halves
structure.camera: drift: same sky drift, pill fixed
structure.motion: width grows on springs.layout about 20 fr; middle label opacity 0 to 1 on easings.outQuint 15 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: the pill opens into a dark rounded card: 3 stats row, inner panel with the pill row, two endpoint codes, an empty progress track, two buttons
structure.motion: card grows down from the pill on springs.layout, settled by 3.77 (about 15 fr, ±0.25 s); text fades in late, dim at 3.27, full at 3.77; buttons rise last

structure.shot: a hero vehicle image slides in from the left edge of the inner panel; progress fill grows from 0 to about half
structure.motion: image enters from x -100 % to centre on easings.outExpo about 30 fr (±0.25 s); progress fill on easings.outQuint 30 fr to about 55 %

structure.shot: live hold: cloud puffs pass right to left across the image inside the panel; the progress fill creeps from about 55 % to 65 %
structure.motion: clouds loop at easings.linear, one pass about 2 s (±0.25 s); progress easings.linear about 1.5 %/s; card itself static

structure.shot: the card folds back up: buttons and stats go first, image exits right, card shrinks into a wide pill
structure.motion: card height collapses on springs.ui about 12 fr (±0.25 s); contents fade on easings.inExpo 8 fr (±0.25 s)

structure.shot: wide pill narrows back to the compact pill and holds, matching the first frame for the loop
structure.motion: width shrinks in steps on springs.ui, compact by 15.00 (±0.25 s); hold 45 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: accent paints the right chip and the status dot; card stays near-black
params.content.pill: left label (short value), middle label (id, 1-2 words), right chip text
params.content.stats: 3 small stats for the card top row, value + caption each
params.content.endpoints: two short endpoint codes with a date caption each
params.content.hero: transparent PNG of the moving object shown in the panel
params.content.progress: start and end fraction of the progress fill (default 0 -> 0.55 -> 0.65)
params.timing.openAt: frame the pill opens into the card (default 98 at 30 fps)
params.aspect: 9:16 first; 4:5 and 1:1 keep the phone centred

notes: No cuts, no audio: one continuous morph loop. Measured from 4 fps sheets (±0.25 s). Expansion pill to card 3.00 to 3.77, collapse 12.50 to 12.77. The sky drifts all the time so no frame is static. Yellow accent chip not captured by palettegen (too small); sample it from a keyframe crop in phase B. SFX planned by the glue rule, not measured (reference is silent). Proposed terms (not in vocabulary): live-activity-card, cloud-pass, progress-fill.
